summary: Frontend E2E (Pro, temporary TEST_ui83 boat) of Walkthrough Folder Peek, Folder Contents Cards PDF, Magic Marine Navigator (intro, no route map, weather photos, reminders, why note) and Leaving Dock Departure heading + Ship's Log departure decision. Backend regression test_weather_departure.py re-run: 4/4 pass. All requested flows passed on desktop and 390px mobile. Found 2 minor design issues, no functional bugs.

issues: The dialog runs edge to edge (left 0, right 390) with no side margin, so the amber border touches the screen edges. Nothing overflows horizontally. The weather full-view dialog uses w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)]; add the same to DepartureLogDialog's DialogContent.
A pin label pill near the left edge (x=0.2, 'Saloon nav desk cupboard') sticks out past the left edge of the map image. Probably not new in this change.

action_items: Optional: give DepartureLogDialog a mobile side margin (w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)])
Optional: keep zone pin label pills inside the map image bounds in the walkthrough
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.toggle computes tickDeparture(items, id) from the render-time items rather than a functional update. Very fast double taps could act on stale state. Low risk.
The 'over 12 hours old' stale warning on weather photos was not run in the UI (it needs an old timestamp). Code review only.

After a Departure decision is logged, the weather photos stay in the Route Hazards panel marked logged:true. Removing them later keeps the stored file, which is intended so the log keeps its photos. Photos removed before logging are soft-deleted (is_deleted true), as expected.
verified: Route Hazards: navigator-intro (3 paragraphs) is the element right after the 'ASK THE MAGIC MARINE NAVIGATOR' label. No .leaflet-container before or after a real Ask (answer came back, advice + advice_at saved to boat.weather).

Weather photos: uploaded 5 via weather-photo-input. At 5 the add button is disabled and reads '5 photos added (remove one to add another)'. Age text shows. Remove brings the count to 4 and re-enables the button. Full view opens and the image loads. Note and navigator-why-input persist after reload. navigator-reminders shows both reminders.

Leaving Dock (seeded heading, and also built in the UI with add + ordering-mode indent): a normal item ticks on its own; one child ticked does not tick Departure; all children ticked auto-ticks Departure and opens the dialog; unticking a child unticks Departure; ticking Departure ticks all children. The dialog shows 4 photos and why; 'Not now' closes without logging; 'Log it' closes and adds the entry.

Ship's Log: 'Departure decision - Mana to Picton - <time>' with depart-log-toggle folding/unfolding depart-log-answer (why, route, photo notes). 4 log-photo thumbnails; log-photo-<id>-0 opens full view with the image loaded. DB has detail + weather_photos, and the photos are marked logged.

Boat Inventory: inventory-folder-cards-btn 'Print contents cards for 2 folders and boxes' downloads a valid %PDF. Backend PDF text has one card per folder with parent, zone and items. The button is hidden when no area has a parent_id.

Crew walkthrough (2 stops): the Saloon stop shows walkthrough-folders-title, and both folder rows start closed. The toggle opens the items (Paper charts x3, Tide tables x1); the empty box shows 'Nothing listed in here yet'; tapping again closes it. The Cockpit stop (no sub-areas) has no folders title.
Mobile 390px: the navigator panel, weather photo slots and departure dialog have no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390).
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ui83 boat (via ui83_setup.py) and 5 item_photos for it. All removed: boat deleted, item_photos for boat TEST_ui83 deleted, users.last_boat for test-user-pro unset (it was null before).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python /app/backend/tests/ui83_setup.py setup|teardown` to create or remove TEST_ui83: areas a_nav (subs a_red with 2 items, a_box empty) and a_cockpit on one zone map, Leaving Dock seeded with 101 Tidy lines, 102 Departure, 103/104 indented children, 105 Fenders, and route Mana to Picton. teardown does not delete item_photos; delete them by boat_id TEST_ui83 + owner test-user-pro. Boat Inventory list id is boatInventory. Open the zone map with zone-map-toggle before using crew-walkthrough-btn. Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest.
